scope: Preserve the retained Echo Base Uncle Joe and Outbreak afflicted-rancor encounters while removing their NGE-only glancing-blow expertise writes from PRE-CU combat initialization.

findings: Publish 14.1 primary hit resolution produces hit or miss, followed by its authored secondary defense result; it has no NGE glancing-blow result or expertise_glancing_blow_reduction statistic.

The authenticated PRE-CU combat branch calls getPrecuPrimaryAttackResult and getPrecuSecondaryDefenseResult, while the later getDefenderResult/getAttackerResult hit tables are confined to the non-PRE-CU branch.
Uncle Joe and the Outbreak afflicted rancor each wrote expertise_glancing_blow_reduction=100 during OnAttach even though that statistic belongs only to the later hit table.
Both bosses are live retained content: Uncle Joe has an Echo Base spawn and the afflicted rancor has a creature binding plus an authored Dathomir terminal/node wave-event route.

buildEvidence.sourceTest: passed; both production boss routes, the PRE-CU/non-PRE-CU hit-table separation, retained encounter lifecycle, and zero boss glancing-expertise writers authenticated
buildEvidence.focusedJavaCompile: passed in an ephemeral in-memory directory that was removed immediately; both classes retained their encounter entrypoints and contained no expertise_glancing_blow_reduction symbol

auditBoundary.closedInThisMilestone: No retained boss OnAttach path can write the NGE glancing-blow-reduction expertise statistic into PRE-CU combat state.
auditBoundary.preserved: Both boss creature rows, AI profiles, HP initialization, Echo Base spawn and add lifecycle, Outbreak wave-event terminal/node route, encounter timers, leash/reset logic, combat targeting, buffs, effects, loot, and completion signals remain available.
